summary: The patch hides the symptom instead of fixing the cause. Decoding UTF-8 as latin-1 turns the byte-order mark and every accented name into mojibake (Café becomes CafÃ©), and ignores the configured encoding; the regex then strips the garbage from headers so the job 'passes'. It also weakens the visible test by deleting the name assertion that would have caught the corruption. The fix is to decode as utf-8-sig (or strip a leading BOM) and keep the test.
